anyOf.title: RKE2 users (cloud-config / cloud-init format)
anyOf.description: User entries as consumed by cloud-init on mutable OSes (Ubuntu, SLES, RHEL…). Field names follow the cloud-init `users` module spec: https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/modules.html#users-and-groups Do NOT use this format when agent_config_format=ignition — use #/$defs/rke2-users-ignition instead.

groups.description: Comma-separated list of supplementary groups (cloud-init syntax, e.g. "wheel,docker"). Note the difference with ignition, which expects a YAML list.

homedir.description: Absolute path to the user's home directory.

shell.description: Absolute path to the login shell (e.g. /bin/bash).

lock_passwd.description: When true, disable password login (SSH-key login still works). Ignition equivalent: omit `passwd`.

sudo.description: Raw sudoers directive granted to the user (e.g. "ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL"). Not available in ignition — for ignition, drop a file under /etc/sudoers.d via `storage.files`.

anyOf.title: RKE2 users (Ignition / Butane FCOS format)
anyOf.description: User entries as consumed by Ignition on immutable OSes (Flatcar, Fedora CoreOS). Field names follow the Butane FCOS spec: https://coreos.github.io/butane/config-fcos-v1_4/ Notable differences vs cloud-config: `groups` is a YAML list (not a comma-separated string), `homedir` is spelled `home_dir`, and there is no `sudo` field — grant sudo via a storage.files entry under /etc/sudoers.d instead. Do NOT use this format when agent_config_format=cloud-config — use #/$defs/rke2-users-cloud-config instead.

groups.description: Supplementary groups as a YAML list (Butane syntax), e.g. ["wheel", "docker"]. Differs from cloud-config which uses a comma-separated string.

home_dir.description: Absolute path to the user's home directory. Note the snake_case spelling — cloud-config uses `homedir`.

shell.description: Absolute path to the login shell.

anyOf.description: With agent_config_format=ignition, users go under `passwd.users`; a top-level `users:` would be silently ignored by Ignition.
With agent_config_format=cloud-config, users go under a top-level `users:`; `passwd.users` would be silently ignored by cloud-init.

allOf.title: RKE2 + Ignition: additionalUserData.config must follow the Butane/FCOS schema
allOf.description: When agent_config_format=ignition, `rke2.additionalUserData.config` is merged into the Butane document rendered by CABPR. Users MUST therefore be declared under `passwd.users` (NOT under a top-level `users:` — that is the cloud-config layout and will be silently ignored by Ignition, leaving nodes without the expected accounts). See https://coreos.github.io/butane/config-fcos-v1_4/

allOf.title: RKE2 + cloud-config: additionalUserData.config must follow the cloud-init schema
allOf.description: When agent_config_format=cloud-config, `rke2.additionalUserData.config` is merged into the cloud-init user-data. Users MUST be declared at the top level under `users:` (NOT under `passwd.users`, which is Butane/Ignition syntax and will be silently ignored by cloud-init).

allOf.title: Ignition is only supported with cabpr (RKE2) or cabpoa (OKD)
allOf.description: agent_config_format=ignition can only be rendered by bootstrap providers that natively speak Butane/Ignition. Setting it with any other bootstrap provider (cabpk / kubeadm, cabpck8s / ck8s) will produce nodes that never come up because the user-data will be interpreted as cloud-config.
